scope: Eight directly inspected individual primary-source records across three source families; source-level judgment, not independent review or complete source-specific 37-case audit.
rights: Only identifiers, hyperlinks and original DTFC paraphrases recorded. Upstream text, test vectors and incident data are not imported; reuse permissions must be separately checked before redistribution.

records.title: Missing authorization
records.basis: Missing authorization is not the same as a present but overscoped delegation. DTF-002 requires a delegation scope and its authoritative chain.
records.reproduction: Review linked source and canonical case proposition, trigger, required evidence and falsification; compare exact condition.
records.rights: Identifiers and links only; no upstream bulk content imported.

records.title: Incorrect authorization
records.basis: General incorrect authorization is broader than the temporal revocation condition and historical-rule exception of DTF-001.
records.reproduction: Review linked source and canonical case proposition, trigger, required evidence and falsification; compare exact condition.
records.rights: Identifiers and links only; no upstream bulk content imported.

records.title: Signature-based correlation
records.basis: Repeated proof values, signature material and key identifiers can link presentations despite payload minimization. DTF-032 captures the privacy assurance proposition.
records.source_status: Group Note Draft, work in progress

records.title: Status lookup correlation
records.basis: Credential-specific status requests can expose presentation events; DTF-033 tests the observable lookup, not just the returned status value.

records.title: Identifier-based correlation
records.basis: A single long-lived identifier may correlate by itself; DTF-036 specifically requires a combined disclosure whose parts are individually non-identifying. No equivalence.

records.title: Issuer-side correlation
records.basis: Issuer-controlled issuance cadence, keys and metadata can defeat privacy despite valid credential/proof checks, the falsification target of DTF-035.

records.title: Prompt injection
records.basis: Only injection that promotes untrusted instructions to decision authority matches DTF-028; other output manipulation or exfiltration requires different propositions.
